title.narrative: COMMUNITY HEALTH, NUTRITION AND HIV

description.narrative: Capacities at Primary health care level are strengthened to provide improved access, quality and coverage of essential high impact maternal, newborn and child health and nutrition and HIV interventions especially at the community level through integrated and multi-sectoral approach that promotes child survival and development and sustained community engagement, with a special focus on prevention, treatment and control of common childhood killer diseases, the prevention of chronic malnutrition and micronutrient deficiencies, and improved quality and equitable paediatric and adolescent HIV services, toward the prevention of vertical HIV transmission.
